name: Futaba Miyu
source:
"I love you, Tanezaki-kun."
[[i]Oh no, what should I do if he really thinks I like him?[/i]]

Miyu is a third year student from Class C who is a classmate of the protagonist. She is a petite girl who is often harshly bullied by the other girls, and is also teased by her companions due to her timid nature. She was the one who called out to him in a gentle voice after he was left in a pitiful state by the bullies.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0406/]DMM[/url] and the [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/mojika/]official website[/url]]
